Summarise a SpatialData store

Source: R/read.R
sdata_info.Rd

Runs the bundled sdata_info.py with system2() and reads the JSON it writes. Useful for checking which coordinate system holds microns before exporting.

Usage

sdata_info(
  sdata,
  points_key = "transcripts",
  python = NULL,
  log = tempfile("sdata_info", fileext = ".log")
)

Arguments

sdata

Path to the SpatialData .zarr store.

points_key

Points element for which row count and coordinate extent are computed (this can take a while for large stores). NULL computes it for every points element.

python

Interpreter override; see punkst_setup().

log

Log file for the script's output.

Value

A list with points (per element: columns, attrs, rows, max_x, max_y, transformations), images (pixel sizes at full resolution), shapes, tables and spatialdata_version.

Examples

store <- file.path(tempdir(), "demo.zarr")
dir.create(store)
#> Warning: '/tmp/RtmpzOxovb/demo.zarr' already exists
res <- tryCatch(sdata_info(store), error = function(e) NULL)
res
#> NULL
